gotchas.title: Class action exceptions are legally binding
gotchas.description: Rules referencing class action settlements (e.g., CS-4471, 2009-CV-118) are legally binding exceptions. Never approve removal without legal sign-off. These exceptions often exist in code but not in documentation.

discoveredFrom.description: BR-DISC-EXCEPTION shows code implements CS-4471 exception but spec doesn't mention it — 11 years out of sync

gotchas.title: Legacy pricing grandfathering must be preserved
gotchas.description: Plan-7 customers retain locked-in pricing per 2009 class action settlement. Even though documentation says 'legacy pricing retired 2012', code correctly preserves this. Never remove grandfathering logic.

discoveredFrom.description: Manual entry by lead during rule review
